It supports transparency, benchmarking and medicines optimisation by helping practices monitor prescribing patterns, costs and alignment with best practice.

## About this dashboard
The CI1 Practice Items Report provides a comprehensive overview of all prescription items issued by a practice and processed by NHS Prescription Services. This report captures data at item level, including drug name, quantity, prescriber details, and associated costs, enabling practices to monitor prescribing behaviour and validate claims.

Users can filter data by time period and therapeutic category, supporting bespoke analysis and benchmarking against regional and national averages. The report is particularly useful for identifying prescribing trends, monitoring compliance with clinical guidance, and informing medicines optimisation initiatives.

The aim of the CI1 Practice Items Report is to promote transparency and accountability in prescribing. It helps practices and commissioners assess whether prescribing aligns with best practice and cost-effectiveness objectives. While the report offers detailed operational insights, it should be used alongside other dashboards to provide context and inform strategic decisions. Its intention is to support discussions within local health economies, identify areas for improvement, and share best practice across organisations.
